message:
Partial refunds now come out at the right size. `partialRefund` in `src/payments/partial-refund.js` multiplied the amount by `percent` (0–100) without dividing by 100, so every refund was 100 times too large. I changed it to `payment.amount * percent / 100`.

`npm test` passes: all 20 tests, including the two in `test/payments-partial-refund.test.js`.
